1 Cyber Security Consultant - Identity and Access Management (f/m/div) Your Profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed
You are a proactive and solutions-driven professional with strong communication skills, able to collaborate with diverse stakeholders and articulate ideas clearly in an international environment. With a customer-focused mindset and a drive to identify challenges, push initiatives forward, and continuously improve, you thrive in a role where critical thinking and innovation shape the way ahead.
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, IT Security or related field of study

 * Deep expertise in Identity & Access Management (IAM), including authentication, authorization, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, federation concepts, and IAM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Active Directory/Entra ID)
 * Strong knowledge of identity-related security controls for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments, including identity providers, directory services, and access management platforms
 * Advanced IAM architecture and system design skills, covering modern access control models, session management, API access security, and service-to-service identity
 * Experience performing cybersecurity risk assessments, threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE), across software and infrastructure systems
 * Strong understanding of security principles (least privilege, ZeroTrust, defense in depth, trust boundaries), and cryptographic concepts relevant to IAM (e.g., token signing, certificate-based authentication, key management)
 * Proven experience aligning IAM controls with enterprise risk management, compliance frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 29146), regulatory expectations, and audit requirements
 * In-depth knowledge of IAM capabilities for modern cloud-native and distributed platforms, including token-based authentication, just-in-time access, workload identity, and federation protocols
 * Fluency in English (mandatory)

1 Senior Process Expert SAP FI/CO (f/m/d) At PALFINGER, we have been lifting goods to a new level for over 90 years - with a pioneering and passionate spirit. As a global technology and engineering company, we are the world's leading manufacturer and supplier of innovative crane and lifting solutions. Our success is based on the tireless efforts of our approximately 12,350 employees, who contribute their ideas and energy to our vision. With us, you can expect a dynamic working environment full of opportunities for personal and professional development. Become part of our team and start your career at PALFINGER.

As part of the Global Service Process & Data Organization, you will work across all Service process areas and collaborate with global stakeholders and regional teams. To further strengthen our global process and data governance and to ensure operational stability across ongoing and future transformation initiatives, we are looking for a Senior Process & Data Manager with a strong cross-process mindset and hands-on governance experience. In this role, you will oversee the operational execution within the Service Process & Data Organization, act as a key coordination link between the Process Owner, global process experts, ICT, Business Process Management and relevant stakeholders. You will support governance, compliance and performance monitoring to ensure consistent global implementation, standardization and documentation.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES
 * You govern the global Service process landscape, ensuring quality, consistency, lifecycle management and documentation approvals
 * You own the global Service change request backlog, coordinating cross-process input, supporting prioritization and conducting structured impact evaluations (business value, profitability, Clean Core, scalability)
 * You design and maintain cross-system roles and authorization concepts, ensuring SoD compliance and alignment with global governance standards
 * You support the implementation of global process templates and operational changes, coordinate incidents and govern justified exceptions while minimizing process customization
 * You coordinate Service reporting requirements, ensure end-to-end process KPI definitions, and act as a governance and quality gate between business stakeholders, process experts and the data & analytics organization, driving effective communication and end-user enablement

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS
 * Several years of experience in process management, data management or business operations in a complex, international environment - Service experience is a strong advantage
 * Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA processes, process governance, roles & authorizations and Clean Core principles
 * Strong analytical skills and experience in evaluating change requests, cross-process impacts and preparing decision-ready assessments
 * Experience with process documentation and governance tools (e.g. Signavio) and reporting or BI environments
 * Very good communication skills in English; German is a plus

WHAT WE OFFER
 * Flexible working hours with no core time and possibility to work from home
 * Further training and international career opportunities
 * Corporate health management "PALfit"
 * Company restaurant with freshly prepared meals and daily meal subsidy
 * Job ticket for travel to and from PALFINGER
 * Numerous employee discounts through Corporate Benefits

jobs.description:
1 Power Electronics Engineer (f/m/d) Medium Voltage & High-Power Conversion Systems  * As part of our interdisciplinary team, you support the design, development and validation of high-power isolated power converters up to MW range as well as the development of converter topologies for medium-voltage applications up to 30 kV.
 * You design and optimize DC/DC, AC/DC, and DC/AC converters as well as solid-state transformer architectures.
 * You contribute to the development of resonant and soft-switching topologies and support the integration of medium voltage high frequency transformers, medium-voltage insulation systems, and high-frequency magnetic components.
 * You perform electrical, thermal, and magnetic simulations using tools such as PLECS, MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice/PSIM, and ANSYS Maxwell or other FEM-based tools.
 * You define power-stage architectures, including semiconductor selection (SiC, IGBT, MOSFET), gate-driver design, protection concepts, and EMC/EMI mitigation measures.

 * You collaborate closely with mechanical, control, and system engineers to ensure successful end-to-end product integration.
 * You ensure compliance with relevant industrial standards, safety requirements, and certification guidelines.
 * You use real-time-simulation platforms (PLECS RT BOX and OPAL-RT) for basic testing of developed hardware.
 * You work on research and development projects, prepare technical reports and scientific publications, and present research results to customers, research partners, and colleagues.
 * You represent the company's expertise in medium-voltage and high-power engineering to customers, partners, and other external stakeholders.
 * You contribute to the scientific and technical advancement of the field by participating in international conferences and engaging in technical committees.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

 * Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
 *  Experience in power electronic systems
 * Expertise in medium voltage systems (up to 20 kV), high-power converters (up to MW), and isolated converter topologies.
 * Understanding of medium-frequency transformer design, medium-voltage insulation systems, magnetic components, and thermal management.
 * Experience with wide-bandgap semiconductors (SiC preferred)
 * Knowledge of power converter control strategies, including closed-loop control, PWM techniques, and digital control systems.
 * Familiarity with laboratory equipment for medium-voltage testing and power analysis
 * Ability to troubleshoot complex power electronic systems
 * business-fluent English ; German skills are a nice to have.

 

What to expect:

 * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 61.334,--. The actual salary will be determined individually, based on your qualifications and experience. In addition, we offer company benefits, flexible working conditions (incl. Home-Office) and individual training and career opportunities.
 * Mentorship and training in embedded firmware and power systems
 * The opportunity to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge power converter technologies in a collaborative and innovative engineering environment.

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates and documents, as well as a proof of identity.
